Shot my very first engagement session a few days back. Could use some feedback about it:

https://www.flickr.com/photos/bfunder94/albums/72157660872069674

The couple wanted to do a lot of shots with the truck. Not what I would have preferred, but they were the ones paying me lol

Truck aside, here are my thoughts:

  • In the first pic, the exhaust is right on top of the guy's head, this is distracting.

  • Not sure what lens you're using, but I'd shoot wider open if possible. Most of the pics would be far better if they were thrown out of focus more.

  • Not entirely your fault, but the faces are very 'staged'. IMO the two strongest pics are the ones where they're kissing on the back of the truck, and the one with the arms intertwined.

  • I don't want to discourage you, but these pics are kind of boring. No interesting angles, no leading lines to pull the eye to the couple. I found this collection of engagement shots, some of which are quite good. You could look for inspiration: http://junebugweddings.com/photo-contests/best-of-engagement/2013

Hope some of this helps! Just keep shooting! :)

Thanks for the critique! I definitely agree with all of your points. I even took some where the exhaust wasn't coming out of his head (I just didn't post it on Flickr for some odd reason). I took most of these with the 50 1.8.

I had wanted to rent a 70-200 2.8, but don't have much money right now so I couldn't. Funnily enough I also shot one that used leading lines, but it was out of focus :( so I couldn't use it. I think I did decent for my first time though! Thanks again :)

Even with the truck, the exhaust adds some distraction. If I can speak subjectively, the black and white ones seemed more genuine to me. The color ones seem a little forced. I like the B&W ones.

Don't worry about your gear. Everyone takes these photos with a 70-200 at 2.8, AT 200 2.8. don't think you have to. I think those types of engagement shoots are cliche at this point.
